tools.name: search_plugin_source
tools.description: Search the EliteMobs, MagmaCore, BetterStructures, FreeMinecraftModels, CannonRTP and ResurrectionChest source code for a query. By default searches every mirrored repo by file content (grep). MagmaCore contains shared core functionality (Lua engine, base entity tables, scripting helpers) used by every plugin — always check it for hooks, helpers, or context methods that feel like they should be common across plugins. FreeMinecraftModels (freeminecraftmodels) has its own LuaItemTable / LuaPropTable and prop-specific hooks. Use this BEFORE answering plugin-specific questions or generating Lua/YAML files.

query.description: Text or regex to grep for. Symbol names, hook names, error messages.

repos.description: Optional. Defaults to every mirrored repo.

mode.description: "content" (default) greps file contents; "path" matches file paths.

path_prefix.description: Optional. Restrict to a subdirectory like "src/main/java/".

tools.name: fetch_plugin_source_file
tools.description: Fetch a file from a mirrored plugin source repo. Optional line slicing for large files.

line_end.description: Optional. Read up to and including this line.

tools.name: get_local_lua_reference
tools.description: Read the current Nightbreak Forge local Lua validator/editor reference. Use this to see which hooks, fields, methods, exact values, and handle helpers the editor currently knows about. **Pass `script_type` matching the file you are working on:** `"lua-power"` (default, EliteMobs boss powers — includes context handles, `em`, and exact values), `"fmm-script"` (FMM props), or `"npc-script"` (EliteMobs NPC scripts in `npc_scripts/`), or `"mind-behavior"` (EliteMobs Mind AI programs in `behaviors/`, selected by a boss's `behavior` field), `"fmm-pet-behavior"` (FreeMinecraftModels pet behavior modules in `pet_behaviors/`, id `fmm:pet/<file name>`; loaded from FMM 2.13.0), or `"em-enchantment-script"` / `"fmm-enchantment-script"` (the Lua effect of an EliteMobs or FreeMinecraftModels enchantment in `enchantments/`). Each returns that script type's own hooks and `context.*` namespaces — the boss reference does NOT contain NPC, FMM, Mind or enchantment APIs, so query the matching type.

script_type.description: Which script type's reference to return. Defaults to "lua-power".

scope.description: Optional scope. For lua-power: "hooks", "context", "boss", "player", "event", "script", "handles", "em", or "values". For fmm-script/npc-script: "hooks", "context", or a context namespace name (e.g. "npc", "player", "prop", "projectile").

tools.name: validate_lua_power_draft
tools.description: Validate a draft Lua script against the local Nightbreak Forge Lua validator. Use this before finalizing generated Lua files to catch unknown helpers, invalid fields, or malformed file structure. **IMPORTANT: pass `script_type` matching the file you are generating.** Use `"lua-power"` (default) for EliteMobs custom-boss Lua powers (files in `powers/`), `"fmm-script"` for FreeMinecraftModels prop scripts (files in `scripts/`), `"npc-script"` for EliteMobs NPC scripts (files in `npc_scripts/`), `"mind-behavior"` for Mind programs and modules (files in `behaviors/`), `"fmm-pet-behavior"` (FreeMinecraftModels pet behavior modules in `pet_behaviors/`, id `fmm:pet/<file name>`; loaded from FMM 2.13.0), or `"em-enchantment-script"` / `"fmm-enchantment-script"` for EliteMobs or FreeMinecraftModels enchantment scripts (files in `enchantments/`). They have different valid hook names and context namespaces — passing the wrong type produces false-positive errors (e.g. `on_right_click` is valid for `fmm-script`, `on_npc_interact` for `npc-script`, but both are rejected for `lua-power`).

content.description: Full Lua script file content to validate.

script_type.description: Which validator ruleset to apply. `"lua-power"` for EliteMobs boss powers, `"fmm-script"` for FMM prop scripts, `"npc-script"` for EliteMobs NPC scripts, `"mind-behavior"` for behaviors/ programs and modules, `"fmm-pet-behavior"` (FreeMinecraftModels pet behavior modules in `pet_behaviors/`, id `fmm:pet/<file name>`; loaded from FMM 2.13.0). Defaults to `"lua-power"`.

path.description: Optional path such as "powers/example.lua" or "scripts/fireball_wand.lua" for reporting context.

tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Search the Nightbreak wiki for relevant pages and snippets. Matching is by word and case-insensitive, ranked by title, page name and body. Each result has a `page` value to pass to fetch_wiki_page. Use for high-level docs, examples, and tutorials — not for symbol verification (use search_plugin_source for that).

query.description: Keywords to search for, such as "lua power files", "creating bosses", or "elitescript bridge".

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: fetch_wiki_page
tools.description: Fetch and extract readable content from a specific Nightbreak wiki page such as "EliteMobs/lua_getting_started". Page names change as the wiki grows: take them from search_wiki results. A missing page returns `suggestions` with the closest existing pages.

path.description: Wiki page path relative to the site root, for example "EliteMobs/lua_getting_started" or "EliteMobs/creating_bosses".

tools.name: get_authoring_notes
tools.description: Where each config type's files go and the plugin rules Forge's own assistant follows: per-type notes, the newer plugins' knowledge, boss movement and combat AI, and the Lua hook quick reference. Read it once before writing files.

tools.name: list_config_types
tools.description: The config file types Forge knows for the released plugins, with each type's plugin, label, server path, format and wiki page. Pass a type to get_config_schema or as the path when validating.

plugin.description: Optional plugin id to filter by, such as "elitemobs", "betterstructures" or "fmm".

tools.name: get_config_schema
tools.description: One config type's fields as Forge edits and validates them: key, value type, default, whether it is required, description and allowed values. Long option lists are shortened; pass field to get one field with all its options.

type.description: A type from list_config_types, such as "custom-boss" or "fmm-pet".

field.description: Optional field key; returns only that field, with every allowed value.

tools.name: validate_config_files
tools.description: Validate plugin config files (YAML and Lua) with Forge's validator: required fields, allowed values, plugin rules, Lua analysis, and references between the files you send (a boss's powers, a dungeon's bosses). Send each file with its server path, such as "plugins/EliteMobs/custombosses/frost_king.yml", so Forge can tell its type. A reference to a file you did not send is reported as not found in the workspace, which here means this call's files. Up to 50 files per call. Nothing is stored.

path.description: Server path or plugin-relative path, such as "plugins/EliteMobs/powers/frost_nova.lua".
